measures.id: Proposed Amendment to the County of Allegheny Home Rule Charter
measures.title: Repeal of Article III, Subsection 7(c): County Council Staff, District Offices and Benefits
measures.summary: Repeals Article III, Subsection 7(c) of the Allegheny County Home Rule Charter, which bars County Council members from receiving County funding for personal staff, district offices, and fringe benefits such as health and life insurance, pensions, or personal motor vehicles. Council members currently receive only a stipend. The change does not itself create a budget or funding allocation for these benefits.
measures.yesMeans: The restriction is removed, so County Council members could in the future receive County funding for personal staff, district offices, and fringe benefits.
measures.noMeans: The Charter continues to bar County Council members from receiving County funding for personal staff, district offices, and fringe benefits.
